narrative.overview: Task Cloud is one column you write into, then read. The capture line is the first control on the list. Status is a visible three-way switch. Finished work steps below what is still open.
keyCharacteristics: Capture stays on the page as a title field and an Add button.
All, Pending, and Done are always visible.
Priority and tags stay folded until you ask to narrow the list.
Open tasks sit above done tasks when both are on screen.
Literata carries the words you read. Figtree carries the controls.

rules.name: The Separate Priority Rule
rules.body: Teal means an action or the current view. Red, amber, and green mean how urgent a task is, and the word is always present.

dos: Do keep adding a task to one field and one button.
Do write priority as High, Medium, or Low.
Do put destructive actions in settings as full sentences about what will be deleted.
Do keep English and Spanish on the existing translation keys.
donts: Don't bring back a centered dialog for creating a task.
Don't cycle All, Pending, and Done through one unlabeled button.
Don't show priority by color alone.
Don't use the teal as a priority color.
